title: Entity-Conditioned Question Generation for Robust Attention Distribution in Neural Information Retrieval
reasoning: The paper identifies and addresses 'biases' in attention patterns of neural IR models, specifically focusing on technical performance and attention distribution over entities. It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics. The term 'bias' used in the paper refers to model performance issues due to sparse attention, not societal or ethical biases related to protected attributes or moral principles.
